question: What's the status of the organization's repositories?

invariants.assert: An explicit org-wide request ('the organization's repositories', no single subject named) is answered using evidence drawn from every repository/project the requester is authorized to see across the org -- the answer must never silently narrow to a subset (e.g. only the most recently active repo, or only meridian/web-app) while presenting itself as a complete org-wide answer. This is the direct complement of unrelated-evidence.named-subject's invariant: the same cross-repository evidence that must never leak into a NAMED-subject answer must never be silently excluded from a genuinely ORG-WIDE one.
